beats.text: I've been taking these biotic breast gummies for about a week now.
beats.textZh: 我吃这款益生菌丰胸软糖大约一周了。

beats.text: And I'm gonna tell you what I like the best about them, other than the flavor, is the fact that they are individually wrapped.
beats.textZh: 除了味道，我最喜欢的是它们是独立包装的。

beats.text: I don't have to worry about them getting stuck to the side of the bottle. And then I can't get them out, and I have to throw the bottle away.
beats.textZh: 不用担心软糖粘在瓶壁上倒不出来，最后整瓶只能扔掉。

beats.text: So I'm gonna link them for y'all.
They come in a pretty good size container,
and this one here has, well, it's 30 days' worth, because you take two gummies a day. That's what's recommended, and that's what I've been taking.
beats.textZh: 这一罐是 30 天的量，每天吃两颗，这是推荐用量，我也是这么吃的。

beats.text: So I'll highly recommend these to you.
beats.textZh: 所以我非常推荐给你们。
